query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.createdAt,
       s.id as subId, s.planType, s.status as subStatus, s.expiresAt
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.userId = u.id
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
